# workflows

`ci.yml` runs Node 24.13.0/Bun 1.4.0, exact src/reference inventory, lint, static tests
and MCP compatibility tests. It does not obtain recovered dependencies or claim a full build.

`qualify-npm-runtime.yml` and `publish-npm.yml` retain their names but fail closed:
the original implementation needs fresh source-derived authorization and native receipts.
They have no token permissions, artifact reuse or publication steps. Previous releases
remain historical; changing source ownership is not authorization to republish it.
